acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Free thiol groups were further alkylated by 10 mM S-methylmethanethiosulfonate (MMTS) at RT for 10 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Free thiol groups were further alkylated by 10 mM S-methylmethanethiosulfonate (MMTS) at RT for 10 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: rLys-C (Wako Pure Chemical Corporation, Osaka, Japan) and sequencing grade trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) were added in 1:25 enzyme-to-substrate ratio (w/w) and proteins were digested at 37 °C overnight.

rLys-C (Wako Pure Chemical Corporation, Osaka, Japan) and sequencing grade trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) were added in 1:25 enzyme-to-substrate ratio (w/w) and proteins were digested at 37 °C overnight.

enrichment_method.evidence: top 14 ballast proteins (e.g. serum albumin, transferrin, immunoglobulins, α-1-antitrypsin, etc.) were removed using highly selective depletion mini spin columns (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were separated using an XBridge BEH column C18, 2.5 μm, 2.1 μm × 150 mm (Waters, Milford, MA, USA) in a linear gradient of mobile phase B (80% AcN/10 mM NH4FA) at a flow rate of 0.3 mL/min.

fragmentation_method.evidence: inferred: Eluted peptides were introduced into Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer via a Nanospray Flex ion source (both Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany).

ionization_type.evidence: Eluted peptides were introduced into Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer via a Nanospray Flex ion source (both Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
Eluted peptides were introduced into a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer via an EASY-Spray ion source equipped with an HESI-II probe (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany).

reduction_concentration.evidence: Reversibly oxidized cysteines were reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP) at 37 °C for 60 min.

reduction_reagent.evidence: Reversibly oxidized cysteines were reduced with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP) at 37 °C for 60 min.
